name: Travel Safety
description: Traveler safety check-in: collects itineraries, lets travelers self-report safe arrival via tokenized links, and emails admins about unaccounted travelers.
project_description:
This module creates a form and a method for checking on travelers to make sure they get to their destination safely.

 Features 
 This module creates a form that collects flight information, emergency information and a preferred method of contact. After the form is submitted it allows people to check in when their flight lands. If they have not checked in after a configurable time, this sends a digest of not-checked in attendees so the administrator can reach out to make sure they are safe. 

 Post-Installation 
 There are additional settings you can modify at /admin/config/people/travel-safety

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 If the captcha module is detected a captcha field will be added to the form.
